---
title: "Visualización 1 - Histograma"
author: "Moreno Silvestre, Jesús"
output: html_document
---

```{r preparar-histogram, include=FALSE}
library(palmerpenguins)
library(ggplot2)

penguins <- read.csv(path_to_file("penguins.csv"))

penguins_validos <- penguins[
  !is.na(penguins$body_mass_g),
]

# Límites comunes para comparar las dos vistas
limites_masa <- c(2600, 6400)

# Estilo compartido
tema_histogramas <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 18,
      face = "bold",
      colour = "#252525",
      margin = margin(b = 8)
    ),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(
      size = 12,
      colour = "#555555",
      margin = margin(b = 15)
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      size = 10,
      colour = "#555555",
      hjust = 0,
      margin = margin(t = 15)
    ),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      size = 14,
      colour = "#252525",
      margin = margin(t = 10)
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      size = 14,
      colour = "#252525",
      margin = margin(r = 10)
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      size = 12,
      colour = "#444444",
      margin = margin(t = 5)
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 12,
      colour = "#444444",
      margin = margin(r = 5)
    ),
    
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(
      colour = "#E5E5E5",
      linewidth = 0.4
    ),
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 14,
      face = "bold",
      colour = "#252525",
      margin = margin(t = 8, b = 8)
    ),
    panel.spacing = grid::unit(1, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 15, 15)
  )

# Histograma general
histograma_general <- ggplot(
  penguins_validos,
  aes(x = body_mass_g)
) +
  geom_histogram(
    binwidth = 200,
    boundary = 0,
    fill = "#287C8E",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(3000, 6000, by = 500),
    labels = scales::label_number(
      big.mark = " ",
      decimal.mark = ","
    ),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = limites_masa) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribución de la masa corporal de los pingüinos",
    subtitle = "Intervalos de 200 g",
    x = "Masa corporal (g)",
    y = "Número de pingüinos",
  ) +
  tema_histogramas

# Histogramas por especie: mismos intervalos y escalas entre paneles
histograma_especies <- histograma_general +
  facet_wrap(~ species, ncol = 1, scales = "fixed") +
  labs(
    title = "Distribución de la masa corporal por especie",
    subtitle = "Intervalos de 200 g · Escalas comunes entre especies"
  )
```

```{r general-histogram, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=4.2, out.width="90%", fig.align="center"}
print(histograma_general)
```

```{r especies-histogram, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.width=11, fig.height=6, out.width="90%", fig.align="center"}
print(histograma_especies)
```
